title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — September 19, 2026

There’s a new CME in NASA’s DONKI, so Sunny is looking at the corona.

☀️ CME start: September 19, 2026 at 18:48 UTC
💨 CME speed: 321 km/s
🏷 CME SCORE: S-type (<500 km/s)
📐 CME half-angle: 45° (Wide)
📍 Source: N14E90 (near the eastern limb)

Sunny is watching the corona. 👀🌌

Image: NOAA SWPC — LASCO C2
Data: NASA DONKI + NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
